name: Autumn Blast

body:
Source Ultimate Wilderness pg. 58, Occult Origins pg. 8
Element earth, wood; Type composite blast (Sp); Level —; Burn 2

Blast Type physical; Damage any two of bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing (half each)
